verdict.rationale: Reclaim's docs confirm Scheduling Links that let others book time across one or many calendars, with "smart meeting controls" and per-link priority settings. That gives a booking-link foundation, but nothing documents distinct event types with their own settings. Missing for 10: evidence of multiple configurable event types, per-type durations, per-type locations, custom booking questions, confirmation/approval rules, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
